issues.title: Reassess the dspy-template-adapter unblock path

tasks.text: Review upstream issue status for parser and partial-demo fixes

issues.note: Reviewed the local blocker map for dspy-template-adapter and chose a DSPx-local patched path instead of waiting on or vendoring the adapter immediately: mixed-provider runtime v4 now exposes explicit `vllm-local`, `openai-compatible`, and `dspy-lm-auth` providers, provider health/benchmark tooling, optimize defaults, and receipt-safe runtime metadata while exact-fidelity template-adapter work stays optional/upstream-blocked.
